title: About the Author
text: JOHN GREEN is an award-winning, #1 bestselling author of Looking for Alaska , An Abundance of Katherines , Paper Towns , Will Grayson, Will Grayson (with David Levithan), and The Fault in Our Stars . His many accolades include the Printz Medal, a Printz Honor, and the Edgar Award. He has twice been a finalist for the LA Times Book Prize. With his brother, Hank, John is one half of the Vlogbrothers ( youtube.com/vlogbrothers ), one of the most popular online video projects in the world. John lives with his family in Indianapolis, Indiana. You can join the millions who follow John on Twitter ( @realjohngreen ) and tumblr ( fishingboatproceeds.tumblr.com ) or visit him online at johngreenbooks.com.
